"Chaaho tum, ya socho nahi—right tum hi ho."
Hazaar mile ki yatra ek kadam se shuru hoti hai.
"Ya to grow kar rahe, ya die—bas."
Tum waise hi bante ho jaise tumhare dost hain.
"Iron garam hone ka wait mat karo."
Victory preparation se pyaar karti.
Tum occasion tak nahi uthte; tum apne level pe girte ho.
Mind ko success ka home banao.
Khamoshi se mehnat karo, success shor machaye.
Optimism ek choice hai.
Apne thoughts badlo aur apni duniya badal jaegi.
Destination overnight nahi badlega, but direction abhi badal sakte.
